sidebar.schedules_the_power_off_for_when: Schedules the power off for when the current job ends or, if there is none, the next one that starts and ends. It's not immediate: that's what "Power off now" is for.
sidebar.works_even_with_no_screen_open: Works even with no screen open. Warns 1 minute before. If a job is running at that time, it does not cut it: it powers off when the job ends.
sidebar.when_the_chosen_time_is_up: When the chosen time is up:
sidebar.shuts_down_the_system_and_cuts: shuts down the system and cuts the power
sidebar.timelapse_no_data_from_the_relay: Timelapse: no data from the relay
sidebar.meter_the_smart_meter_or_switch: Meter: the smart meter or switch cuts EVERYTHING (system + Duet + power supply). Relay: a relay on a Duet output (M950 P) that cuts ALL the power. PS_ON: the board turns off its power supply (M81); the system and the board stay on only if they have their own power. Automatic: meter, else relay, else PS_ON. Power off when done and the timer use the same method.
sidebar.stopped_the_video_is_built_on: Stopped: the video is built on the system (Camera > Captures and timelapse).
sidebar.configure_the_bar_what_s_shown: Configure the bar (what's shown, order, lights) on this screen
sidebar.custom_buttons_rail: Custom buttons (macros and G-code, grouped by function)
sidebar.camera_relay_rail: Camera relay (GLOBAL: process on the system, affects everyone)
sidebar.shut_down_now_rail: Shut down now (GLOBAL: shuts down the system and cuts power)
sidebar.arrange_hint: Arrange: drag by the grip dots. Sections move among themselves; each card within its section. Tap Done to finish.
sidebar.this_screen_help: Open/close floating panels on THIS screen. They don't stop any process or affect other users or screens.
sidebar.global_help: They act on the machine and the system: they affect ALL connected people and screens.
sidebar.tap_again_cut_for_everyone: Tap again: cut it for EVERYONE
sidebar.stop_relay_help: Stopping the relay cuts the camera for EVERYONE/every screen watching it now. Use it only to free CPU or stop the process on the system. To stop watching only on your screen, close the camera panel (above, THIS SCREEN).
sidebar.mute_help: Mute is for when you're next to the machine: for 1 hour nothing reaches the phone (for EVERYONE who receives), but events are still logged in Activity. It turns back on by itself.
sidebar.mute_help_no_activity: Mute is for when you're next to the machine: for 1 hour nothing reaches the phone (for EVERYONE who receives). It turns back on by itself.
sidebar.restart_everything_help: Resets the Duet board (M999) and reboots the system, without cutting power. The screen comes back by itself in 1-2 minutes. Asks for confirmation first.
sidebar.panel_this_screen_only_open: {name} (this screen only): open -- tap to close
sidebar.shut_down_when_done_reading: Shut down when done: reading state...
sidebar.shut_down_when_done_not_armed: Shut down when done: not armed
sidebar.when_the_current_job_ends_file: When the current job ends ({file}): {what}. You can cancel it before with this same button.
sidebar.when_the_current_job_ends: When the current job ends: {what}. You can cancel it before with this same button.
sidebar.no_job_running_when_the_next_ends: No job running: when the NEXT job that starts ends: {what}. You can cancel it before with this same button.
sidebar.shut_down_when_done_global_not_armed: Shut down when done (GLOBAL): not armed
sidebar.no_data_from_the_backend: No data from the backend (Workshop Service)
sidebar.notifications_disabled: Disabled (enable them on the Activity page)
sidebar.enabled_but_the_last_send_failed: Enabled, but the last send FAILED: {error}
sidebar.tap_again_to_shut_down_in: Tap again to shut everything down in {t}
sidebar.live_stop_tip: Cuts off what a program is sending live: no more lines get in. On a laser it turns the laser off and saves where it is so it can be resumed. It is not the emergency stop.
sidebar.live_stop_rail: Live job: stop safely (opens the bar)
sidebar.live_stop_confirm_text: The program sending the job is no longer served: no more lines get in and what the machine already accepted finishes moving. On a laser the laser goes off and where it is gets saved, to resume later. Heaters and motors stay as they are. It is not the emergency stop: the power stays on.
sidebar.live_stop_wait: Waiting for the machine to finish the lines it already had…
sidebar.live_stop_done: Job stopped safely: no more lines get in.

hidden.shuts_down_the_system_and_cuts: Shuts down the system and cuts the power (GLOBAL). Asks for confirmation first.

order.only_the_name_is_needed_the: Only the name is needed: the section can stay empty and be filled later with cards or button groups (name, description, macro or G-code).
order.choose_the_section_of_each_card: Choose the section of each card or group in the list above. A section can stay empty: later you add button groups from the section itself (+ Button group).
order.live_stop_on_the_bar: Safe stop of the live job on the bar
order.state_on_the_arrow: State (color and effect) on the arrow
order.status_lights_at_the_top_of: Status lights at the top of the bar
order.on_the_bar_closes_by_itself: On: the bar closes by itself when the mouse leaves it or when you tap outside it. Off: it stays open until you close it with its button.
order.push_page_hint: On: the DWC page narrows so the bar does not cover content (on a very narrow screen the bar keeps floating over the page). Off: the bar floats over the page and, when closed, becomes the arrow (the rail needs to make room so it does not cover DWC).
order.rail_a_narrow_strip_of_icons: Rail: a narrow strip of icons. Arrow: the whole bar hides and only a small arrow is left on the edge. Either way it opens with a tap, floating over the page.
order.uncheck_what_you_don_t_use: Uncheck what you don't use on this screen: it's hidden from the bar and the rail.
order.empty_section_add_a_button_group: Empty section. Add a button group (name, description, macro or G-code) or choose from the gear which cards go here.

buttons.lighting_desc: Work light (LEDs 0-19) and status lights (LEDs 20-36, normally automatic based on the mode and what the machine is doing).
buttons.laser_desc: Laser air assist. Laser mode only.
buttons.cnc_zero_desc: Capture Zero saves the current position as a fixed reference; Set Zero reuses it as the work zero. CNC mode only.
buttons.machine_mode_desc: Switches between 3D printing, laser and CNC (speeds, limits, probe, PWM...). The current mode is disabled. Asks for confirmation.
buttons.power_supply_and_restart_desc: Power supply (motors, laser, spindle) and full restart: resets the Duet (M999) and reboots the system in software, without cutting power.
buttons.power_usage_desc: Energy meter reading and reports (details are on the Power Usage page).
buttons.could_not_read_the_buttons_reply: Could not read the buttons: the machine answered something unexpected. Try again in a moment.
buttons.error_saving_the_buttons: ERROR saving the buttons on the system: {error}
buttons.not_available_with_a_job_running: Not available while a job is running
buttons.no_response_in_15_s: {label}: no response in 15 s. It may have run anyway: check the button state before repeating it.
buttons.title: Title
buttons.active_in_modes_help: Enabled in modes (disabled outside them; a new button comes with its group's modes checked)
buttons.can_be_used_with_a_job_running: Can be used while a job is running
buttons.empty_group_drag_here: Empty group (you can drag buttons here).
buttons.delete_group_with_buttons: Delete the group WITH its buttons (double tap)
buttons.editing_hint: Editing: drag by the grip dots to reorder (also between groups).
buttons.current_mode_hint: Current mode: {mode}. Tap a group title to fold it.
buttons.no_groups_hint: No groups. Tap "Edit buttons" and then "New group".
buttons.buttons_section_help: Custom macros and G-code, grouped by function. They act on the machine (all screens). Grey ones with a dotted border can't be used now (the reason is shown below).

startup_bar.light_tip: Macros of the light buttons of the bar (macros/light). Edit them for your machine: a LED strip, a lamp on an output or your own macro.
startup_bar.air_tip: Macros of the air buttons of the bar (macros/laser). Only if your machine has an air pump or valve; otherwise tap "Do not use".
startup_bar.psu_tip: Macros of the motor power supply buttons (macros/psu). Only if the Duet switches the supply; otherwise tap "Do not use".
startup_bar.light_what: A macro file (a small G-code program) that turns the light of your machine on or off. Every machine does it differently: with a LED strip, with a lamp on an output of the board or with a macro of your own.
startup_bar.light_for: The light buttons of the bar run this file. The button only appears when the file has at least one active line.
startup_bar.light_missing: The light buttons do not appear or do nothing. The rest of the bar works the same.
startup_bar.air_what: A macro file that turns the air assist of the laser (a pump or a valve) on or off. It only exists on machines that have one.
startup_bar.air_for: The air buttons of the bar run this file.
startup_bar.air_missing: The air buttons do nothing. If your machine has no air, tap "Do not use" and this row stops bothering you.
startup_bar.psu_what: A macro file that switches the power supply of the motors on or off from the Duet board. It only makes sense if the Duet controls the supply.
startup_bar.psu_for: The power supply buttons of the bar run this file.
startup_bar.psu_missing: The power supply buttons do nothing. If your supply is switched by hand or some other way, tap "Do not use".
startup_bar.q_method: How does your machine do it?
startup_bar.q_method_tip: Pick the closest one. If you are not sure, pick "A macro of mine" and type the path of one you already have.
startup_bar.q_output_tip: The P number you set up with M950 in your config.g. Do not guess: check your config.g.
startup_bar.q_macro_tip: It starts with 0:/ and ends in .g, for example 0:/macros/light/my-light.g. The assistant only calls it, it does not create it.
startup_bar.q_leds: How many LEDs the strip has
startup_bar.q_leds_tip: The number you set up in your config.g. If you are not sure, keep the value and change it later.
startup_bar.q_white: Does your strip have a white channel (RGBW)?
startup_bar.q_white_tip: If it is RGB without white, choose No.
startup_bar.q_fan: Number of the fan used as air
startup_bar.q_fan_tip: The F number you set up with M950 in your config.g.
startup_bar.q_speed: Speed of the air when on
startup_bar.q_speed_tip: From 0 (stopped) to 1 (full). Decimals are fine, for example 0.8.
startup_bar.opt_service: The system service paints the strip (recommended; Lights page)
startup_bar.opt_strip: A LED strip connected to the Duet
startup_bar.opt_output: An output of the board (lamp, relay, valve)
startup_bar.opt_atx: The ATX power-on pin of the board
startup_bar.opt_relay: A relay on an output of the board
startup_bar.g_light_desc: Turns the machine light on and off from the bar.
startup_bar.g_air_desc: Turns the laser air (pump or valve) on and off.
startup_bar.g_psu_desc: Turns the motor power supply on and off from the board.
startup_bar.modal_sub: Get the files used by the bar buttons ready
startup_bar.strip_text: {n} left to set up for the bar
